messages:
mia-csm: Heads-up: HalcyonFin dropped ~48% MAU over the last 14 days. Renewal in ~6w, main champion (CTO Ravi) left last week. Need quick triage and a short playbook. @oliver-sales can you confirm procurement timing and competitor signals?

oliver-sales: Saw the note. They kicked off an evaluation with AetherAI 3 days ago. Procurement hinted at an accelerated timeline — could be 3–4w if legal moves fast. They asked for performance/cost comparisons.

jae-support: I pulled their org logs — no big error rate historically, but yesterday we saw a spike in 429s and a burst of timeout retries from their integration. Pasting the snippet:```\n2024-04-09T14:12:03Z halcyon-org-82 429 rate_limit exceeded \n2024-04-09T14:12:05Z halcyon-org-82 504 upstream timeout \n```

ben-platform: Thanks @jae-support. Looks like they're bumping into rate/throughput limits — traffic pattern changed (longer prompts + more concurrent sessions). We can spin a short-lived Dedicated pool for testing to show consistent latency. Also can enable prefix KV cache for their typical flow to cut tokens and latency.

mia-csm: Good notes. Proposed immediate steps: 1) schedule 30m war-room with HalcyonFin + product demo + run Dedicated trial offer; 2) ops to reproduce 429s in staging; 3) sales to fast-track a procurement NDA if needed. Who owns ops reproduction? @ben-platform?

ben-platform: I can own the repro. I'll request an ephemeral Dedicated pool and run a focused load test using their example prompts. ETA: 24–48h.

oliver-sales: I'll open the procurement cadence and offer a 2-week complementary Dedicated trial (controlled quota) — frame as "validate latency & throughput for production traffic". I'll escalate pricing and legal to speed NDA.

jae-support: I'll stitch together a short troubleshooting note for their engineers: how to surface 429s, preferred retry/backoff, and a sample headers checklist. Will post in thread and also DM their lead eng.

ops-bot: Automated alert added: halcyon-org-82 high-429-rate (yesterday) -> ticket CS-11872 created. Assigned to ben-platform.

mia-csm: Nice — target: call with customer by EOD Thursday. Oliver, can you confirm availability? Also I'll prep a tailored prompt set and a 1-page perf brief comparing typical gen cost/latency vs AetherAI (high-level).

oliver-sales: Confirmed — Thursday 3pm PT works for their PM and procurement rep. I'll share calendar invite and attendee list.

mia-csm: Next: Ben — please run the load test and post a short write-up with 90th latency and token-cost delta. Jae — send the troubleshooting note and ask if they saw any recent change in prompt templates. I'll prepare the enablement deck focused on cache + batching benefits.

jae-support: On it. Also recommend we include a small SDK snippet showing best-practice retry/backoff: ```js
fetch('/v1/generate', { headers: { 'x-org-id': 'halcyon-org-82' }})
  .then(r => { if (r.status === 429) backoffAndRetry() })
```

mia-csm: Thanks team. If trial shows stable latency and cost improvements we pitch a short reserved commit. If not, we capture exact regression points for model/infra follow-up.

ben-platform: Will update with preliminary numbers in ~30h.

oliver-sales: I'll draft the trial terms and send to legal tonight.

mia-csm: Perfect. I'll run the call agenda and own the enablement slide. Tagging core owners: @ben-platform (repro), @jae-support (eng note), @oliver-sales (procurement & trial).

jae-support: quick q — do we want to run their real prompt templates in the Dedicated trial or anonymized synthetic traffic? Privacy concern if they prefer anonymized.

mia-csm: Ask them on the kickoff — default to anonymized/sampled prompts unless they sign an NDA. We'll offer both.

ops-bot: Reminder: CS-11872 update due in 48h.

mia-csm: Great progress. I'll post a short pre-read for Thursday and link this thread. :thumbsup:
